maddeler.e:
نستهزئ (form X)
# نَسْتَهْزِئُ (nastahziʔu) /nas.tah.zi.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهْزَأَ (istahzaʔa)
# نَسْتَهْزِئَ (nastahziʔa) /nas.tah.zi.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَهْزَأَ (istahzaʔa)
# نَسْتَهْزِئْ (nastahziʔ) /nas.tah.ziʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَهْزَأَ (istahzaʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
